items.q: (Well that was Billy's?). As a matter of fact, he borrowed it and it didn't work.

ctx.x: Well I watched you with the equipment the other night and I think something happened to it.
(Well that was Billy's?). As a matter of fact, he borrowed it and it didn't work.
It was just the way it was all set up, (unintelligible) planning for days and something is wrong with the equipment.
